correctness.rationale: Exact coupling to Poisson stick lengths gives GEM(alpha) orientation weights; pairwise sphere inner-product covariance yields the exact conditional squared error. Independent beta-recursion and generator derivations agree on E[Q_d] and E[Q_d^2]. A finite-vector multivariate CLT for normalized Gaussian directions plus a dimension-uniform conditional L2 bound proves the infinite weighted Gaussian limit. A max-weight squeeze combined with the exact size-biased GEM intensity gives both sharp endpoint amplitudes. The standalone verifier passed 260 supportive finite checks; no numerical check is treated as a proof.
